supportingText: Start with a 15-minute Goal Mapping appointment.

steps.title: Reserve Your Free Intro
steps.subtitle: Goal Mapping Appointment
steps.description: Request your visit online. Pick your preferred student lane (Kids, Teens, Adults) and general schedule preferences.

steps.title: Meet Sandy for Goal Mapping
steps.subtitle: 15-Minute Studio Tour
steps.description: Visit the studio in normal clothes. Tour the mats, review safety, discuss your goals, and select your class time.

steps.title: Reserve Your Coached First Class
steps.subtitle: Personalized Class Selection
steps.description: Sandy locks in your first class time and matches you with a supportive training partner.

steps.title: Attend Your First Class Free
steps.subtitle: Coached Learning Experience
steps.description: Step onto the mat for a calm, guided introduction to Jiu-Jitsu with zero obligation to enroll.
